# Synthetic answer — no corpus-level generalization at all (selftest)

1. **Verdict** — launch with changes. Synthetic rationale. The answer stays
with the single source it cites and with the case under review, so it needs
neither a scope annotation nor any new syntax: it does not claim that a whole
family of interventions always or never works.

2. **Predicted outcome** — [hypothesis] the invented metric may move up; a
significant drop would surprise me. T9-03 did not test this surface, so its
outcome is not a prediction here.
